title: SkillMaxx: GitHub login in Vault
message: SkillMaxx: to let me open the awesome-list PRs from the SkillMaxx GitHub account (not your personal one), please save that account's GitHub login in Grok Bot under Settings > Vault (site github.com, name it "GitHub (SkillMaxx)"). If it has 2FA by authenticator app, tell me in chat when you're around. That's all.
